rows.root_cause: the implementation applies only the lower bound
rows.behavioral_requirement: return min for values below min, max for values above max, otherwise value
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function clamp(value, min, max) { return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value)); }

rows.root_cause: even-length inputs select the upper middle element instead of averaging both middle elements
rows.behavioral_requirement: odd median is middle; even median is average of two middle values; do not mutate input
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function median(values) { const v=[...values].sort((a,b)=>a-b); const m=Math.floor(v.length/2); return v.length%2 ? v[m] : (v[m-1]+v[m])/2; }

rows.root_cause: an unnecessary sort destroys first-occurrence order
rows.behavioral_requirement: deduplicate using SameValueZero semantics while retaining encounter order
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function unique(values) { return [...new Set(values)]; }

rows.root_cause: the loop excludes a partial tail and accepts an invalid step
rows.behavioral_requirement: partition all items; final group may be short; positive integer size required
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function chunk(values,size){ if(!Number.isInteger(size)||size<=0) throw new RangeError('size'); const out=[]; for(let i=0;i<values.length;i+=size) out.push(values.slice(i,i+size)); return out; }

rows.root_cause: comparison uses raw text without normalization
rows.behavioral_requirement: compare lowercase ASCII alphanumeric characters only
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function isPalindrome(text){ const value=text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,''); return value === [...value].reverse().join(''); }

rows.root_cause: parseInt accepts partial strings and no range check exists
rows.behavioral_requirement: return integer 1..65535 for digits-only strings, otherwise null
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function parsePort(value){ if(!/^[0-9]+$/.test(value)) return null; const n=Number(value); return n>=1&&n<=65535 ? n : null; }

rows.root_cause: delay is linear and returns zero for the first attempt
rows.behavioral_requirement: min(cap, base times two to the zero-based attempt)
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function retryDelay(attempt,base,cap){ return Math.min(cap, base*(2**attempt)); }

rows.root_cause: global slash collapsing corrupts the URL scheme and does not isolate the join boundary
rows.behavioral_requirement: preserve scheme and normalize only trailing/leading boundary slashes
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function joinUrl(base,part){ return `${base.replace(/\/+$/,'')}/${part.replace(/^\/+/,'')}`; }

rows.root_cause: the character class omits several regex metacharacters
rows.behavioral_requirement: escape . * + ? ^ $ { } ( ) | [ ] and backslash
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function escapeRegExp(value){ return value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\$&'); }

rows.root_cause: each assignment overwrites the existing group
rows.behavioral_requirement: append values to groups in encounter order
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function groupBy(values,key){ const out={}; for(const value of values) (out[key(value)]??=[]).push(value); return out; }

rows.root_cause: the loop excludes the inclusive endpoint
rows.behavioral_requirement: sum start through end inclusive when start <= end
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function sumRange(start,end){ let sum=0; for(let i=start;i<=end;i++) sum+=i; return sum; }

rows.root_cause: ellipsis is appended after taking the full width
rows.behavioral_requirement: result length never exceeds width; ellipsis occupies one character
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function truncate(text,width){ if(text.length<=width) return text; if(width<=0) return ''; if(width===1) return '…'; return text.slice(0,width-1)+'…'; }

rows.root_cause: filtering empty segments discards whether the path was rooted
rows.behavioral_requirement: collapse repeated separators and preserve leading root state
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function normalizePath(value){ const rooted=value.startsWith('/'); const body=value.split('/').filter(Boolean).join('/'); return rooted ? '/'+body : body; }

rows.root_cause: string truthiness makes every non-empty value true
rows.behavioral_requirement: true/false case-insensitive only; invalid values yield null
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function parseBool(value){ const v=value.toLowerCase(); return v==='true' ? true : v==='false' ? false : null; }

rows.root_cause: the implementation always uses decimal KB and mishandles sub-unit values
rows.behavioral_requirement: bytes below 1024 use B; otherwise binary KiB rounded to one decimal
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function formatBytes(n){ if(n<1024) return `${n} B`; const value=n/1024; return `${Number(value.toFixed(1))} KiB`; }

rows.root_cause: filter preserves duplicate members from the left input
rows.behavioral_requirement: unique intersection in first-left-occurrence order
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function intersection(left,right){ const r=new Set(right); return [...new Set(left)].filter(x=>r.has(x)); }

rows.root_cause: application/x-www-form-urlencoded plus-space semantics are omitted
rows.behavioral_requirement: replace plus with space, then percent-decode
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function decodeQuery(value){ return decodeURIComponent(value.replace(/\+/g,' ')); }

rows.root_cause: literal-space splitting creates empty words and preserves inconsistent casing
rows.behavioral_requirement: trim, split all whitespace, capitalize first and lowercase remainder
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function titleCase(value){ return value.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map(x=>x[0].toUpperCase()+x.slice(1).toLowerCase()).join(' '); }

rows.root_cause: truthiness rejects a valid zero numerator
rows.behavioral_requirement: only a zero denominator is invalid
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function safeDivide(a,b){ return b===0 ? null : a/b; }

rows.root_cause: distance is not normalized and empty/negative cases are mishandled
rows.behavioral_requirement: normalize integer distance modulo length; negative means left; do not mutate
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function rotate(values,n){ if(!values.length) return []; const k=((n%values.length)+values.length)%values.length; return k===0 ? [...values] : values.slice(-k).concat(values.slice(0,-k)); }

rows.root_cause: lower-bound loop dereferences an empty array and obscures exact-match termination
rows.behavioral_requirement: standard exact binary search with inclusive bounds
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function binarySearch(values,target){ let lo=0,hi=values.length-1; while(lo<=hi){ const m=(lo+hi)>>1; if(values[m]===target)return m; if(values[m]<target)lo=m+1;else hi=m-1; } return -1; }

rows.root_cause: object spread treats header names as case-sensitive
rows.behavioral_requirement: later case-insensitive key wins and supplies retained casing
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function mergeHeaders(left,right){ const out={}; for(const [k,v] of [...Object.entries(left),...Object.entries(right)]){ const prior=Object.keys(out).find(x=>x.toLowerCase()===k.toLowerCase()); if(prior) delete out[prior]; out[k]=v; } return out; }

rows.root_cause: zero is injected into maximum calculation
rows.behavioral_requirement: extrema come only from inputs; empty yields null
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function minMax(values){ if(!values.length)return null; return {min:Math.min(...values),max:Math.max(...values)}; }

rows.root_cause: literal-space splitting counts empty tokens and ignores other whitespace
rows.behavioral_requirement: trim and count non-empty runs separated by any whitespace
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function countWords(text){ const value=text.trim(); return value ? value.split(/\s+/).length : 0; }

rows.root_cause: calling an instance method is unsafe when shadowed or absent
rows.behavioral_requirement: use the intrinsic hasOwnProperty with call
rows.reference_fixed_source: export function hasOwn(value,key){ return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value,key); }
